svg.title: Vector search and RAG flow in the AI PM Copilot
svg.desc: Illustrative flowchart showing how a user query is embedded, compared against stored vectors, top-k results retrieved, and injected into the LLM context window.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kinds of queries trigger a vector search in the copilot?')
sendPrompt('How does the embedding model turn text into vectors?')
sendPrompt('How many results does the copilot retrieve from the vector store?')
sendPrompt('How are retrieved chunks injected into the LLM context?')
